text.en: RPent results on this leaderboard come from different evaluation dates; each source note identifies its run.
text.zh: Leaderboard 中的 RPent 成绩来自不同评测日期；各来源注释标明对应批次。

text.en: LIBERO / LIBERO-PRO: all VLA-based RPent methods use the same RLinf-Pi05-LIBERO-130-fullshot-SFT checkpoint, released by RLinf, as the pi_RLinf baseline. This checkpoint was supervised-fine-tuned on LIBERO-130; RPent does not further fine-tune it for LIBERO-PRO, and its weights remain frozen during evaluation. Motor Only does not use a VLA.
text.zh: LIBERO / LIBERO-PRO：所有使用 VLA 的 RPent 方法均采用与 π_RLinf 基线相同的 RLinf-Pi05-LIBERO-130-fullshot-SFT checkpoint。该模型由 RLinf 发布，已经过 LIBERO-130 监督微调；RPent 未针对 LIBERO-PRO 额外微调，评测期间权重冻结。Motor Only 不使用 VLA。

text.en: RoboCasa365: RPent uses RLDX-1-FT-RC365 released by RLWRLD, not an RLinf checkpoint. It was fine-tuned on RoboCasa365; RPent does not further fine-tune its weights and keeps them frozen during evaluation.
text.zh: RoboCasa365：RPent 使用 RLWRLD 官方发布的 RLDX-1-FT-RC365，而非 RLinf checkpoint。该模型已针对 RoboCasa365 微调；RPent 未额外微调其权重，评测期间保持冻结。

text.en: RoboTwin: RPent uses LingBot-VLA-RoboTwin-EEF-ckpt1500 released by RLinf, a LingBot-VLA checkpoint supervised-fine-tuned on RoboTwin data. RPent and the direct LingBot-VLA baseline use the same checkpoint with frozen weights during evaluation.
text.zh: RoboTwin：RPent 使用 RLinf 发布的 LingBot-VLA-RoboTwin-EEF-ckpt1500，该 LingBot-VLA checkpoint 已经过 RoboTwin 数据监督微调。RPent 与直接 LingBot-VLA 基线使用相同 checkpoint，评测期间均冻结权重。

text.en: Methods may differ in training data, exploration / memory, inference budgets, and result selection. External results follow their original sources; the environment-specific VLA notes identify same-checkpoint comparisons.
text.zh: 各方法的训练数据、探索 / memory、推理预算及结果选择方式可能不同；外部方法按原来源报告，同 checkpoint 对照见各环境的 VLA 说明。

text.en: ASPIRE: Long Task and Long Swap use zero-shot transfer from the LIBERO-90 skill library.
text.zh: ASPIRE：Long Task 和 Long Swap 使用 LIBERO-90 技能库进行 zero-shot 迁移。

text.en: RPent Flash Mode uses directly downloaded, officially released GPT-5.5 exploration memory, Molmo2-8B for visual localization, and the same VLA as pi_RLinf for action execution. The displayed scores are the best evaluation results from s0-s9.
text.zh: RPent Flash Mode 使用直接下载的、官方公开的 GPT-5.5 explore memory，Molmo2-8B 用于视觉定位，动作执行使用与 π_RLinf 相同的 VLA。展示成绩采用 s0-s9 中的最佳评测结果。

text.en: RPent / GPT-6 Motor Only uses motor-only control: it directly outputs end-effector pose increments and gripper commands through execute_action, without invoking VLA / primitives or loading memory.
text.zh: RPent / GPT-6 Motor Only 为纯电机控制方法，通过 execute_action 直接输出末端位姿增量与夹爪指令，不调用 VLA / primitive，不加载 memory。

text.en: GPT-6 Astra (memory-enabled configuration): Long Task/Swap and the other six suites use separate memory-file snapshots frozen after their respective exploration phases, with no updates during evaluation. Overall combines two non-overlapping batches: Long 157/200 plus the other suites 584/600, giving 741/800 (92.63%); the 800 episodes do not share a single memory snapshot.
text.zh: GPT-6 Astra（使用 memory 的配置）：Long Task/Swap 与其余六套件使用各自探索后冻结的 memory 文件快照，评测期间不更新。Overall 合并两个不重叠批次：Long 157/200，加上其余套件 584/600，得到 741/800（92.63%）；并非全部回合共享同一份 memory 快照。

text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash evaluated with memory explored by GPT-6 Astra.
text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 使用 GPT-6 Astra 探索的 memory 评测。

text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash evaluated with its own seed-0 exploration memory.
text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 使用自身 seed-0 探索的 memory 评测。

Official model identity. RPent uses Molmo2-8B for visual localization only.

Eight Task/Swap aggregates from 800 unique contributor result.json cases, checked against summary.json and published family totals. Each component includes all 100 expected cases (task IDs 0–9, seeds 0–9). The 20 no-card cases remain in the denominator and are not counted as successes.

The experiment contributor confirmed that the RoboCasa GPT-6 Astra evaluations used high reasoning effort. This corrects the configuration label for the reported success rates and time/token results; their numeric values and evaluation coverage are unchanged. LIBERO-PRO and RoboTwin retain their separately reported configurations.

The contributor corrected the full evaluation to 340 cells on 2026-09-20. Split denominators follow the existing RPent Target50 matrix (180/80/80). Reported success rates remain unchanged; full-run success counts are not inferred from rounded or task-weighted rates. The earlier archive is retained as historical local evidence, not as verification of the corrected full-run counts.

Contributor-provided Qwen eight-suite counts and cost table. Mean elapsed time includes all evaluation episodes (success, failure, and timeout); tokens count evaluation-stage output only. No unreported planner, hardware, or token accounting details are inferred.

Contributor-reported complete Long Task evaluation on another server: 38 successes in 100 episodes. Codex / GPT-6 Astra / low reasoning; execute_action motor-only control without VLA / primitives or memory. This aggregate is independent of the incomplete local motor-only campaign; no unreported suite, runtime, or token measurements are inferred.

Codex / GPT-5.5 / xhigh reproduction on reproduce/libero reports Long Task 70/100 and Long Swap 55/100. The updated leaderboard combines these two results with the six unchanged Table 3 suites: (81+69+94+91+75+66+70+55)/8 = 75.125%, displayed as 75.13%. This derived Overall is not the paper's original aggregate.

The contributor confirms that the displayed Flash Mode evaluation uses directly downloaded, officially released GPT-5.5 exploration memory and the best-performing seed from s0-s9. Molmo2-8B is used for visual localization. No memory snapshot revision is inferred.

Infini deepseek-v4.1-flash with Codex, xhigh requested and reasoning enabled, using memory explored by GPT-6 Astra. Completed eight LIBERO-PRO suites: 720/800 successes. Each suite covers tasks 0–9 and seeds 1–10; timeouts count as failures. Historical retries are not counted twice. Costs average planner elapsed_s and (total_input_tokens + total_output_tokens) across all 800 final episodes, including failure and timeout. Cached input and reasoning output are not added again. Historical attempts are excluded.

Infini deepseek-v4.1-flash with Codex xhigh, using its own frozen published seed-0 exploration memory (343 files). RPent main d3efb4fa and RLinf c52e780f. Eight LIBERO-PRO suites, tasks 0–9 and seeds 1–10: 709/800 native simulator successes, 91 unsolved, zero final errors or timeouts. A historical HTTP 500 cell was rerun; only final episodes count. Mean planner elapsed_s and input plus output tokens use all 800 final episodes; cached input and reasoning output are included within their parent totals.
